issues: Scrambled numbering/formatting: items 7–8 and 19–20 run together on the same line, obscuring list structure.
Meaning drift/typo: Original cites State Gazette year for Law No. 1 of 2000 as 'Tahun 200' (as written in source); translation normalizes it to 'Year 2000', which changes the source text.
Meaning drift: "Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan" translated as "implementation of protection"; more accurate is "administration/organization of protection" in a legal/regulatory context.
Minor formatting/wording issue: missing space in the Indonesian title ("PENYELENGGARAANPERLINDUNGAN") should be reflected as two words in English title ("ADMINISTRATION OF PROTECTION").

Meaning drift in item 4: 'psikis terhadap korban' rendered as 'psychological suffering to the victim' (should be 'psychological [suffering] against/on the victim' / 'psychological suffering experienced by the victim') and structure slightly unclear; needs to clearly list types of suffering inflicted on the victim.

Meaning drift in item 9: 'mengetahui akan, sedang atau telah terjadinya kekerasan' translated as 'knowing that violence ... will occur' (adds certainty); should be 'will, is, or has occurred' in the sense of 'about to occur, occurring, or has occurred'.
Meaning drift/awkward attachment: "based on gender" should modify "violence" (gender-based violence), and "that occur" should refer to the violence/incidents, not the "best interests of victims".

Meaning drift/awkward rendering: final clause omits the sense that services/handling may be provided by individuals, groups, or institutions, whether the Regency Government or non-government; current wording is ungrammatical and can misstate the subject/provider.

Meaning drift/terminology: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" (not "Regent Regulation" without article is fine, but should be "a Regent Regulation" or "Regent's Regulation"; also "prosedur standar opersional" = "standard operating procedures"), and minor meaning issue in item (c): "ancaman dan intimidasi bagi korban" rendered awkwardly as "intimidation for victims"; should be "against victims"/"toward victims" to match meaning.
Meaning drift: "tumpah darah Indonesia" mistranslated as "all the blood of Indonesia"; should be "the entire Indonesian homeland/territory".

Meaning drift/grammar: last bullet mistranslates structure; should state that in all actions concerning victims by government/society/legislative/judicial bodies, the best interests of the victim must be the primary consideration.
Meaning drift/word choice: "whereabouts" should be "existence/location" in context of complaint centers (keberadaan tempat pengaduan).
Minor meaning drift: "development of case handling" should reflect "progress/development in handling the case" (perkembangan penangan perkara).
